svg.title: TCP three-way handshake
svg.desc: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK sync both sides' sequence numbers before any data flows. x and y are each side's initial sequence number. The close is shown as a single FIN and ACK exchange; a real teardown is a four-way FIN/ACK sequence with TIME_WAIT on the side that closes first, and the badges switch to CLOSED/LISTEN as the exchange starts rather than as it finishes. The SYN-ACK is drawn blue (outbound) because it is a new segment, not a reply to data. 1. Listening: server waits on a passive open. 2. SYN: client sends SYN, seq=x. 3. SYN-ACK: server replies SYN-ACK, seq=y ack=x+1. 4. ACK: client sends ACK, ack=y+1. 5. Established: both sides exchange data. 6. Closed: FIN and ACK close it; server keeps listening.
svg.text: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK sync both sides' sequence numbers before any data flows

g.text: server waits on a passive open
FIN and ACK close it; server keeps listening
